evidence: The oxide composition and morphology have, furthermore, been characterized by SEM and TEM. Quantitative and qualitative analyses were performed by the use of the energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) unit in the SEM and the TEM, and with X-ray photon electron spectroscopy (XPS). Two-stage oxidation followed by transverse SIMS proﬁling was applied to determine the distribution of growth across the scale.
